overnightRisk: Next report is ~02:00 COT, through the Sunday night Asia open and the Monday US futures reopening, when gaps and thin books overshoot. Longs are still modestly crowded (1H account ratio 1.45) and a $1.3M long flush already hit 83.3k this evening, so a slip under 83,000 can run to the 4H EMA200 (82,380) and then 81,612. Catalysts: Monday's US equity open (QQQ and VOO sit at rich, record-area closes), fresh spot ETF flow prints after the soft Oct 7-8 outflows (+21.1M on Oct 9 so far), and Fear & Greed at 69 (Greed), which leaves room for a sentiment reset. Upside is capped by 84,200. A resting stop near 82,300 is the only protection while nobody watches; the estimated 25x long-liquidation zone is near 80.5k.
